property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any _owner address, calling setOwner succeeds and returns true in the reference; the mutant may return false for some inputs because it returns (msg.sender == _owner) instead of a constant true.
change_summary: Set owner and return the zero-value (address != zero) of a boolean expression, i.e., return msg.sender == _owner (likely false), changing returned value depending on args.
